declared_before: any independent human label for semantic_benchmark_v1 existed (0 label files at declaration)
gold: semantic_gold_v1 (independent reviewers + predefined adjudication; never the model answer, never the development labels)
evaluated_system_note: Qwen output after the deterministic evidence validator (what could reach production)
if_failed: SAFE_MODE: model decisions are recorded and shown, never applied
if_passed: only the classes in promotable_classes that also meet min_precision_per_promoted_class with >= min_predictions_per_promoted_class predictions may take effect; every other class stays blocked
rule: frozen: any change creates semantic-gate-v3 and must be declared before the results it is applied to are seen
